title: SEAL6 SMG complete third-person + first-person player bundle

semanticCandidate.promotionRule: External GSC dumps are discovery evidence only. Complete-player closure requires the same assembly semantics to be re-resolved from retained retail faction_seals_mp script bytes/output.

animations.scope: retail third-person player animation set compatible with the full-body rig
minimumBehaviorFamilies: death/reaction where owned by the player animation system
animations.rule: Discover from retail animation ownership/animtree evidence; do not infer a family solely from filename prefix.

assemblySemantics.meaning: For this class the complete third-person visible player is expected to be the full-body XModel itself; no separate head list is selected by the class script.

closureGates: full-body XModel identity resolved from retained retail T6 source
retail faction_seals_mp player-class script confirms full-body setmodel + separate viewhands + empty head list
every serialized full-body LOD and surface retained
full skeleton hierarchy and every skin influence retained with no unsupported rows
all full-body material slots resolve to exact Material identities
all full-body Material -> GfxImage dependencies resolve without filename guessing
bounds, part classification, collision metadata, and physics references retained where serialized
third-person player animation ownership discovered from retail evidence and compatibility-checked against the body rig
first-person viewhands + MP7 benchmark gates remain independently satisfied
complete third-person and first-person outputs load in an independent consumer with source/output hashes archived
